# Alerts

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

What is addressed to this desk right now, across every movement and referral.

## What is on the screen

1. Addressed to your desk. Alerts for this desk right now, act now first.
2. Open an alert. Each alert opens the record it is about.
3. Forecast. Forecast lines set in Settings: beds likely to be short tomorrow, the ED access target and a worse forecast.

## Jobs done here

- Find an alert I already cleared. Open the Alerts page. Open is what still needs someone, with chips to show one kind at a time. Cleared lists what this desk acted on, newest first. Broadcasts holds bed calls, live and past.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.
